ic_name: NFC / ISO 14443 (NXP AN10833 MIFARE family — subset)

exposed_dft_features.name: ATQA + SAK identification surface
exposed_dft_features.purpose: Every PICC always exposes a deterministic identification fingerprint (ATQA + SAK + UID) — protocol-built-in observability.

exposed_dft_features.name: ATS historical bytes
exposed_dft_features.purpose: Layer 4 PICCs expose a vendor-readable historical-byte block in ATS that often carries firmware revision and family code.

exposed_dft_features.name: GetVersion (Layer 4 application)
exposed_dft_features.purpose: Newer PICCs (Ultralight EV1 / Plus EV1/EV2 / DESFire EV2/EV3 / DESFire Light) expose a 7-byte HW/SW version block via a single 0x60 command — recommended primary identification per AN10833 Rev 3.7.

exposed_dft_features.name: Card Detect via RF envelope
exposed_dft_features.purpose: PCD chip detects PICC presence via load-modulation envelope on its RX path; visible to host MCU through a status register.

exposed_dft_features.name: PCD collision-bit-position register
exposed_dft_features.purpose: Vendor-specific (CLRC663 / PN5180): pinpoints the bit position where two PICCs diverged during anti-collision — invaluable for multi-PICC debug.

exposed_dft_features.name: PCD CRC / parity / framing error counters
exposed_dft_features.purpose: Vendor-specific: track CRC_A, CRC_B, parity, FIFO over/underflow events.

fields.no_jtag_on_air_interface: There is no JTAG / scan / boundary-scan port on the PICC air interface. The PICC IC has no test pads visible to the PCD — internal scan + parametric tests happen only at wafer probe / package test inside vendor manufacturing. PCD reader chips often expose JTAG / SWD for host-side debug, but this is vendor-specific (not in ISO 14443).
fields.notes: ISO 14443 has no formal DFT / scan architecture exposed at the air interface. The protocol's identification surface (ATQA / SAK / UID / ATS / GetVersion) is itself the standard observability for a freshly-discovered PICC and is highly effective for production-line PICC verification. For protocol-level debug of analog timing or load-modulation amplitude, RF logic analyzers (e.g. Micropross MP500, Riscure Inspector, FME-Sniffer) and reference Calibration Coil Antennas (per ISO 10373-6) are the canonical instruments.
